comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.message: This screen comes with a later work package.

portalHome.title: Welcome to the portal
portalHome.message: Request forms come with a later work package.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter the email of your account: you will receive a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account matches {{ email }}, an email with a link is on its way. The link is valid for one hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.intro: At least 12 characters. A long sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
resetPassword.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.

verify.title: Two-step verification
verify.intro: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
verify.backupIntro: Enter one of the backup codes you kept when enabling two-step verification. Each one works once.

enroll.title: Enable two-step verification
enroll.intro: Your organization requires two-step verification: set it up to continue.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Protect your account: after your password, you will enter a code from an authenticator app (Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator, FreeOTP…).
mfa.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app; the key below gives the same information.
mfa.key: Or enter this key in the app:
mfa.codeHint: Shown by the app, renewed every 30 seconds
mfa.backupCodesIntro: Keep these backup codes somewhere safe: if you lose your phone, each one replaces a code from the app once. They will not be shown again.
mfa.fileTitle: My Little Big Project Planner backup codes
mfa.active: Two-step verification is enabled. Backup codes left: {{ count }}.
mfa.requiredByPolicy: Your organization requires it: it cannot be disabled.
mfa.disableIntro: To disable it, enter a code from the app or a backup code.

acceptInvitation.title: Join an organization
acceptInvitation.missingToken: This invitation link is incomplete. Open the link of the email again.
acceptInvitation.intro: {{ inviter }} invites you to join {{ tenant }}.
acceptInvitation.introNoInviter: You are invited to join {{ tenant }}.
acceptInvitation.existingAccount: You already have an account with this email: accepting adds {{ tenant }} to your organizations. Your password stays the same.
acceptInvitation.external: Your account is ready. You will reach {{ tenant }} through its request portal.
acceptInvitation.sso: You joined {{ tenant }}. It signs you in through its identity provider.

auth.providersIntro: Entra ID, Google, Okta, Keycloak… Members sign in with the provider account whose verified email is theirs. SAML and LDAP directories go through Keycloak.
auth.noProvider: No identity provider yet: members sign in with their password.

internalAccountsRequireSso.label: Internal accounts sign in through the identity provider
internalAccountsRequireSso.hint: Except the members marked as local accounts (contractors outside the directory).

localAccountsRequireMfa.label: Local accounts need two-step verification
localAccountsRequireMfa.hint: Members signing in with a password enable it at their next sign-in.

portalPasswordEnabled.label: Portal: sign-in with a password
portalPasswordEnabled.hint: For the external accounts of the request portal.

portalMagicLinkEnabled.label: Portal: sign-in with a link sent by email
portalMagicLinkEnabled.hint: For the external accounts of the request portal.

auth.ssoWithoutProvider: No identity provider is enabled: the rule applies once one is.
auth.clientSecretKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored secret
auth.emailClaimHint: email (verified by the provider), or a directory claim such as upn
auth.redirectUri: Redirect URI to register at the provider:

members.caption: Members and pending invitations of the organization
members.emptyHint: Change the search or the filters, or invite someone.
members.removeMessage: {{ name }} loses access to this organization at once and leaves its groups. Their account and their other organizations stay.
members.revokeMessage: The link sent to {{ email }} will stop working.
members.removed: {{ name }} was removed from the organization.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.internalHint: Uses the application of the organization.
invite.externalHint: A customer or supplier: uses the request portal only.

member.title: Access of {{ name }}
member.localAccountHint: Signs in with a password even when the organization requires its identity provider (people outside its directory).

groups.intro: Groups let you grant roles to several members at once.
groups.caption: Groups of the organization
groups.emptyHint: Create a group, then add members to it.
groups.deleteMessage: The group goes; its members stay in the organization.
groups.name: Name
groups.noMember: No member in this group yet.

roles.intro: Node roles are sets of permissions, granted on a portfolio, a program or a project and inherited by its descendants.
roles.emptyHint: Create a role, then grant it on the nodes of the hierarchy.
roles.select: Choose a role in the list.
roles.title: Role “{{ label }}”
roles.labelsHint: At least one of the two.
roles.inUse: Grants using this role: {{ count }}. Remove them before deleting it.
roles.deleteMessage: The role goes; no grant uses it.
roles.discardMessage: The changes to this role are not saved.

errors.not_found: This item does not exist or is no longer available.
errors.method_not_allowed: This action is not possible on this item.
errors.request_timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.conflict: This action conflicts with the current state.
errors.precondition_failed: Someone changed this item in the meantime. Reload it before trying again.
errors.payload_too_large: The data sent is too large.
errors.unsupported_media_type: This data format is not accepted.
errors.precondition_required: Reload the item before changing it.
errors.internal: The server ran into an error. Try again later.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

csrf.invalid: Your session could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.

auth.reset_token_invalid: This link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
auth.sso_required: Your organization signs you in through its identity provider: use the button above.
auth.oidc_failed: Sign-in through the identity provider failed. Try again.
auth.oidc_no_member: No member of this organization has the email of this account.
auth.oidc_email_unverified: The identity provider does not confirm the email of this account.
auth.switch_failed: This switch link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Sign in again.

oidc_provider.duplicate: This identity provider is already configured.
oidc_provider.unreachable: The identity provider cannot be reached or answered badly.

idempotency_key.reused: This request was already sent with different data.
idempotency_key.in_flight: This request is already being processed.

tenant.slug_taken: Another organization already uses this identifier.
tenant.confirmation_mismatch: Type the identifier of the organization to confirm its deletion.
tenant.delete_current: You cannot delete the organization you are signed in to.

errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection.

field.out_of_range: The value is out of the allowed range.
field.same_as_email: The password must differ from the email.
field.not_default_slug: In single-organization mode, only the configured identifier is allowed.
field.external_member_only: An external account cannot administer the organization.
field.before_start: The end is before the start.
field.unknown_member: Not a member of the organization.
field.not_using: This project does not use this configuration.

invitation.invalid: This invitation link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
invitation.pending: This email already has a pending invitation: send it again instead.
invitation.already_member: This email already belongs to a member of the organization.
invitation.closed: This invitation was already accepted or revoked.

member.last_admin: The organization needs at least one active organization admin.

group.name_taken: Another group already has this name.

permission.denied: You do not have the permission this needs.

role.label_taken: Another role already has this name.
role.in_use: Grants use this role: remove them first.

account.no_password: Your organization signs you in: your account has no password to change.
account.reauthentication_required: Sign in again through your organization, then delete your account within 10 minutes.
account.platform_admin: A platform super admin cannot be erased: another one must remove the role first.

session.current: This is the current session: sign out instead.

export.pending: The export is not ready yet.

node.key_taken: Another project of the organization has this key.
node.cycle: This link would make the node its own ancestor.
node.parent_not_allowed: This type of node cannot be attached under that parent.
node.grant_exists: They already have this role on this node.
node.confidential_lockout: You would lose your own access: ask for a role granted on the project itself first.
node.archived: This project is archived: it is read-only until it is restored.
node.active_children: This project still has active sub-projects: archive or detach them first.
node.parent_archived: This project is under an archived project: restore that one first.

config.name_taken: Another project configuration already has this name.
config.no_draft: This configuration has no draft: nothing to publish or discard.
config.default: The default configuration stays: new projects get it.
config.in_use: Projects use this configuration: move them to another one first.

issue_type.key_taken: Another type of this configuration already has this identifier.
issue_type.cycle: A type cannot be its own ancestor.
issue_type.subtask_parent: A sub-task type cannot be the parent of another type.
issue_type.last_type: A configuration keeps at least one type that is not a sub-task.
issue_type.orphan_subtask: A sub-task type would have no parent type left: change it first.

workflow.key_taken: Another workflow of this configuration, or status of this workflow, already has this identifier.
workflow.in_use: Issue types follow this workflow: move them to another one first.
workflow.last: A configuration keeps at least one workflow.
workflow.invalid: Workflows of the draft cannot be published as they are: fix what the Workflows tab lists.

security.title: Security
security.mfaOn: Authenticator app · backup codes left: {{ count }}
security.mfaOff: Off: your password alone signs you in.
security.passwordHint: Changing it signs your other sessions out.

password.title: Change your password
password.intro: Your other sessions will be signed out; this one stays open.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions are signed out.
password.incorrect: This is not your current password.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.intro: The devices signed in to your account, in all your organizations. Sign out the ones you do not recognize.
sessions.revokeOf: Sign out the session on {{ device }}

personalData.title: My personal data
personalData.intro: Erasure anonymizes your name and email everywhere, history included. The content of your tickets is kept.
personalData.exportSlow: The export takes longer than expected. Try again in a few minutes.

erasure.title: Delete your account?
erasure.intro: Your account is erased in all your organizations:
erasure.removed: your name, email, password and preferences are deleted;
erasure.pseudonym: you appear everywhere as “Deleted user #N”, history included;
erasure.kept: the content you created is kept, except your comments if you ask so;
erasure.ssoHint: You sign in through your organization: sign in again just before (less than 10 minutes) to delete your account.
erasure.mismatch: This is not the email of your account.

hierarchy.intro: The top of the hierarchy: portfolios, programs and projects, with their aggregated indicators.
hierarchy.caption: Portfolios, programs and projects
hierarchy.empty: No portfolio, program or project yet
hierarchy.emptyHint: Create a portfolio, then its programs and projects.

general.name: Name
general.keyHint: Set at creation: it prefixes the project’s tickets.

dialog.title: New node
dialog.keyHint: 2 to 10 capital letters and digits, a letter first (PLAT).

parentsHint.portfolio: A portfolio can be attached to other portfolios.
parentsHint.program: A program can be attached to portfolios or other programs.
parentsHint.project: A project can be attached to portfolios, programs or other projects.

links.weightNote: The weighting only applies to the aggregates of that parent. Higher up, the node is counted once.

refusal.not_allowed: Impossible: this type of node cannot be its parent
refusal.cycle: Impossible: it is a descendant of this node, the link would create a cycle
refusal.forbidden: You do not administer both nodes

access.title: Effective access
access.empty: Nobody has a role here yet. Organization admins see every node.
access.note: Access is the union of the direct roles and of the roles inherited from every parent.
access.revokeOf: Revoke the role {{ role }} of {{ name }}

dialog.title: Grant a role on {{ name }}
dialog.chooseHolder: Choose a member or a group in the list.
dialog.inherit: The role also applies to everything under this node.

access.inheritedHidden: Inherited from a node you do not have access to

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Blocks inherited access: only the members with a role on the project itself reach it. In the lists of its parents, it stays counted anonymously, without name or detail.
confidentiality.off: The project is no longer confidential.

tree.veiledHint: You do not have access to this project. Its load is counted anonymously.

view.confidentialOpen: including {{ count }} on a confidential project
view.note: Aggregates cover distinct descendant projects: a project attached to several programs is counted only once.
view.caption: What is attached to {{ name }}
view.emptyHint: Add a child to follow its load and progress here.

hierarchy.archivedIntro: The archived projects: read-only, out of the active lists and the aggregates. Open one to restore it.
hierarchy.archivedEmptyHint: A finished project is archived from the Archiving tab of its settings.

archiving.title: Archiving

consequences.readOnly: It becomes read-only: neither it, its attachments nor its tickets can be changed.
consequences.lists: It leaves the active lists; the "Archived" filter finds it.
consequences.aggregates: It leaves the aggregates of its portfolios and programs.
consequences.history: Its history is kept, and it can be restored at any time.

archiving.restoreHint: Restored, it can be changed again and counts again in the aggregates. If its parent project is archived, restore that one first.
archiving.notAdmin: Only the administrators of the project archive or restore it.

confirmArchive.title: Archive {{ name }}?
confirmArchive.message: The project will become read-only and leave the active lists and the aggregates. You can restore it.

confirmRestore.title: Restore {{ name }}?
confirmRestore.message: The project will be editable again and count again in the aggregates.

archiving.bannerHint: It is read-only, out of the active lists and the aggregates.

config.intro: A project configuration gathers the issue types, fields, workflows, screens and notifications of the projects that share it. New projects get the default one.
config.emptyHint: Create one to share a way of working between projects.
config.caption: Project configurations
config.name: Name

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.message: No project uses it. Its versions and its draft are deleted with it.

duplicate.title: Duplicate “{{name}}”
duplicate.intro: The copy starts from the published version of “{{name}}”, without its projects or its draft.

detach.title: Detach {{project}}
detach.intro: {{project}} gets its own copy of “{{name}}”: further changes to the original no longer affect it.

page.upToDate: Version {{number}} is published. Changes go to a draft until they are published.

published.one: Version {{number}} is published to its project.
published.other: Version {{number}} is published to its {{count}} projects.

discard.title: Discard the draft of “{{name}}”?
discard.message: Its changes are lost. The published version stays as it is.

fields.title: Fields come next
fields.hint: System and custom fields, with their rules per type and per step, will be defined here.

screens.title: Screens come next
screens.hint: The creation, view and transition screens will be defined here.

notifications.title: Notifications come next
notifications.hint: Which events notify whom will be defined here.

projects.caption: Projects using this configuration
projects.emptyHint: Move a project to it from the Configuration tab of the project's settings.
projects.veiled: Project you do not have access to

publishDialog.title: Publish “{{name}}”?
publishDialog.none: No project uses this configuration yet: the new version will apply to the projects moved to it.

intro.one: The new version applies at once to this project:
intro.other: The new version applies at once to these {{count}} projects:

publishDialog.migration: Some tickets use a type or a status this version removes: they must be migrated first.
publishDialog.stale: The configuration changed in the meantime: check the projects again, then publish.
publishDialog.workflowProblems: Workflows of the draft to fix first:

node.title: Project configuration
node.hint: Its issue types, fields, workflows, screens and notifications come from this configuration.
node.archived: An archived project keeps its configuration until it is restored.
node.readOnly: Tenant admins and configuration admins change it.

types.intro: The issue types of the projects and the types each may sit under. Changes go to the draft.
types.caption: Issue types, in their order
types.label: Label
types.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and _; it cannot be changed later.
types.keyFixed: Set when the type was added; it does not change.
types.keyFormat: A lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits or _.
types.subtaskHint: A sub-task always sits under a ticket of a parent type, and has none under it.
types.parentsHint: None: its tickets stay at the top.
types.parentsRequired: A sub-task type needs at least one parent type.

remove.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
remove.message: It leaves the draft and the allowed parents of the other types. Tickets using it will have to move to another type before publishing.

workflows.graph: Graph of {{name}}; the statuses and transitions tables below describe it.
workflows.problemsTitle: This workflow cannot be published yet:

problems.no_initial: none of its statuses is the initial one.
problems.unreachable: nothing leads to “{{status}}” from the initial status.

workflows.label: Name

remove.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
remove.message: Its statuses and transitions go with it. No issue type may follow it.

status.initial: Initial status: new tickets start here

remove.title: Remove the status “{{name}}”?
remove.message: Its transitions go with it. Tickets in this status will have to move to another one before publishing.

remove.title: Remove the transition “{{name}}”?
remove.message: Tickets will no longer take it.
